issues.title: Add GET /todos/:id
issues.body: The todo API can list, create, toggle, and delete todos but not fetch one. Add `GET /todos/:id` to src/index.ts: return the todo as JSON, or 404 with `{ "error": "not found" }` (like DELETE) when the id doesn't exist.
issues.acceptanceCriteria:
- `GET /todos/:id` returns the matching todo
- Unknown ids return 404
- A test covers both cases and `npm test` passes

issues.title: Validate empty titles
issues.body: `POST /todos` rejects a missing or empty title, but accepts a whitespace-only one (`"   "`). Trim the title, reject a blank one with 400 `{ "error": "title is required" }`, and store the trimmed title.
issues.acceptanceCriteria:
- Whitespace-only titles return 400
- Titles are stored trimmed
- A test covers the validation and `npm test` passes

issues.title: Customer request: due dates and overdue reminders
issues.body: From a customer call: "I keep forgetting things on my list. Could todos have a due date, and could the API tell me what's overdue?" Nobody has scoped this yet. Triage it against the todo API in src/index.ts: what's the smallest useful change, should it be one task or a small story, and is anything recurring (e.g. a nightly overdue check) worth scheduling?
